title: Consciousness is best studied in large-scale synchrony patterns

statements.text: Cognitive acts need the transient integration of widely distributed brain areas, most plausibly by phase synchrony over multiple frequency bands. The neural basis of consciousness is best sought in large-scale dynamical brain signatures rather than in specific circuits or classes of neurons.

sources.quote: The most plausible mechanism for large-scale integration is the formation of dynamic links mediated by synchrony over multiple frequency bands.
